question: When was the All India Khilafat Conference held in Delhi?
solution:
The correct answer is __'**November 1919**'__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The** All India Khilafat Conference**, a joint conference of the Muslims and Hindus was called at Delhi in pursuance of the Muslim League President Fazl-ul-Haq in** November 1919.**
 
• Leaders are Maulana Mohammad Ali Jauhar Shauk
